name: What each immigration status allows (summary across records)
name_fr: Ce que permet chaque statut d'immigration
description: A cross-reference of what citizens, permanent residents, work-permit holders, study-permit holders and visitors may do in Canada — work, study, provincial health coverage, buying a home, children's schooling, and path to PR — built from the other nat records.

attributes.basis: Agent 01 reading of the cited nat records as of 2026-10-30

citizen.health: yes, subject to provincial residency rules; Quebec applies its up-to-3-month wait even to citizens arriving from abroad (nat-qc-health-coverage)
citizen.children_school: public school; in Quebec English public school only with an eligibility certificate (nat-qc-english-schooling-eligibility)

permanent_resident.health: yes in every province; no wait stated for arrivals from abroad in ON, MB, NB, NS and NL; up to about 3 months in BC, SK, QC and YT; AB timing for PRs not confirmed; PE and NU not found — see nat-<prov>-health-coverage
permanent_resident.children_school: public school; in Quebec French school unless an eligibility criterion is met — PR status alone does not give access to English public school

work_permit_holder.work: yes, under permit conditions (employer-specific or open)
work_permit_holder.study: generally yes for short courses; longer study may need a study permit (not catalogued)
work_permit_holder.health: varies: ON after 6 months full-time; MB with 12-month permit; NS/NL/YT/NU with 12-month permit; AB with 6+ months remaining and intent to stay 12 months; BC/SK with conditions — see records
work_permit_holder.buy_home: exempt from the federal ban if at least 183 days remain on the permit and no more than one property (until the ban ends 1 Jan 2027)
work_permit_holder.children_school: public school (provincial rules); in Quebec a temporary authorization for English school may be available (reported 3-year maximum)
work_permit_holder.path_to_pr: Canadian Experience Class after 1 year skilled work; provincial nominee streams

study_permit_holder.health: excluded in MB; possible in SK, NB, NL (12-month permit), NS (after 12 months), BC (conditions); otherwise private/school insurance
study_permit_holder.buy_home: generally a 'non-Canadian'; student exemption conditions not catalogued
study_permit_holder.children_school: dependants may attend public school (provincial rules)

visitor.buy_home: no (federal ban until 1 Jan 2027, unless property outside CMAs/CAs)

attributes.user_status: unknown — every row must be read against USER-PROFILE.md once citizenship and status are known (OPEN-QUESTIONS.md items 1, 7).

limitations: A summary; individual cases depend on permit conditions and provincial rules. Rows marked 'not catalogued' were outside Phase 1.
